Who we are

Built on experience. Growing with purpose.

Since 1988, Richville Federated Group of Companies has developed and managed properties across the residential, commercial, and hospitality sectors — starting from a single detached house in Ayala Alabang Village.

Today the group develops, leases, and operates its own portfolio, with in-house teams for property development, property management, architectural design, and hospitality operations.

About RFGC

Our story, what we do, and how the group is organised.

Our story What we do Track record Vision & mission FAQ
01

Our story

Richville Federated Group of Companies traces its origins to February 1988, with a single detached house in Ayala Alabang Village. With only a handful of basic equipment, a few workers, and minimal support facilities, its owners and colleagues worked as a team, each contributing their own experience and expertise.

Their persistence paid off as the corporation grew in the business of developing and constructing on its acquired properties. Given the room to explore new ideas, the company expanded from acquisition and construction into property management operations — and, later, hospitality.

What started in 1988 as one detached house in Ayala Alabang Village has grown into a developer across real estate, hospitality, and food. An in-house team of architects, engineers, and planners runs every project from concept to completion, and the group gives back through its Reach Out Ville Foundation.

1988

Founded in Ayala Alabang

A single detached house marks the start of the company’s property development work.

1990s

Expansion into Manila

The company extends its focus from Ayala Alabang into the University Belt and surrounding districts.

2000s

Into hospitality

Vivere Hospitality Group is established, beginning with Vivere Hotel in Filinvest Corporate City.

Today

Thirteen properties, five provinces

Hospitality, leasing, and commercial properties in Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, and Palawan.

What started in 1988 as one detached house in Ayala Alabang Village has grown into Richville Federated Group of Companies, a developer with a footprint across real estate, hospitality, and food. The company was built on modest beginnings and a shared belief that a small, committed team could deliver work of lasting quality. Over the years, that drive turned early home projects into office towers, residential condominiums, and resort properties in Metro Manila and beyond. Behind every project is an in-house team of architects, engineers, and planners who manage each development from concept to completion, keeping quality high and costs in check. Today, Richville continues to grow while giving back through its Reach Out Ville Foundation, supporting Filipino children and families in need.

04

Vision & mission

Our Vision

RFGC began with one vision: to provide and offer to its consumers an upscale lifestyle in dwellings that is accessible to everyone with the standard of excellence, a passion of collaborative design with ethics and integrity.

Mission and Values

RFGC vision is to bring through our professional work an awareness of the values of integrity, honesty, and the spirit to serve, not only to our consumers but also to our colleagues in the workplace.

We are committed…

✓

…to provide highest quality in property development and management

✓

…to ensure consumer satisfaction

✓

…to develop competencies in our colleagues professionally, personally, and culturally

✓

…to give back to the community concretized in REACHOUT VILLE FOUNDATION INC. (ROVFI)

Does RFGC sell units, or only lease them?

How do I book a stay at a Vivere property?
Contact the property directly — the number is on each hospitality property page.

How do I apply for a job at RFGC?
Open roles are listed on the Careers page.

How do suppliers get accredited?
Requirements and the process are on the Partnerships page.

Information for banks, lenders, and investors, and the accreditation route for suppliers and contractors.

For banks, lenders & investors

Due diligence, without the chase

RFGC has operated continuously since February 1988 and holds 13 properties across five provinces. Financial and title documents are kept per asset and released under a signed NDA.

  • Single finance contact for the whole review
  • Asset-level reporting rather than group averages
  • Site visits arranged with the building management team

For suppliers & contractors

Accreditation is open year-round

We accredit by category, then invite accredited suppliers to quote as projects and building requirements come up. One procurement desk covers all four divisions.

  • Civil works, structural, and finishing
  • Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection
  • Fit-out, furniture, fixtures, and equipment
  • Building services — cleaning, security, lifts, landscaping
  • Hotel operating supplies and equipment

How accreditation runs

Four steps, with a written decision at the end of the review so you know where you stand.

Step 01

Send your company profile

Email the documents listed above to our procurement desk. Incomplete sets are held, not rejected.

Step 02

Accreditation review

Procurement verifies documents, capacity, and safety record, then confirms your supply category.

Step 03

Project briefing

Accredited suppliers are invited to site briefings and asked to quote against a written scope.

Step 04

Purchase order

Awarded work runs on a written PO with agreed milestones, retention, and payment terms.

Talk to the right desk directly

Finance and procurement inquiries are answered within one business day. Add "Finance" or "Procurement" to your subject line and we will route it.

Home / Data privacy

Data privacy

How RFGC collects, uses, and protects your personal information under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

Last updated: [add date]  ·  Registered with the National Privacy Commission  ·  DPO/DPS Registration No. [add number]

Who is responsible for your data

Richville Federated Group of Companies (RFGC) is the personal information controller for the data collected through this website and across our divisions — The One Residences, Vivere Hospitality Group, Richville Offices, and ReachOutVille Foundation Inc.

What we collect

  • Contact details you give us — name, email address, and mobile number.
  • Inquiry details — the property, unit type, or role you are asking about, and the content of your message.
  • Application documents, if you apply for a role or submit a resume.
  • Basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited, used only to keep the site working.

Why we collect it

  • To answer your inquiry and route it to the right leasing, hospitality, or corporate team.
  • To process leasing applications, reservations, and employment applications.
  • To send updates about a property you asked about — only where you have agreed to receive them.
  • To meet legal, tax, and regulatory requirements.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with the RFGC division handling your request, with service providers bound by confidentiality agreements, and with government agencies where the law requires it.

How long we keep it

Inquiry records are kept for [add period] from your last contact with us. Tenancy, guest, and employment records are kept for the period required by law, then securely disposed of.

Your rights

Under RA 10173 you have the right to be informed, to object, to access, to correct, to erase or block, to damages, and to data portability. You may also lodge a complaint with the National Privacy Commission.

To exercise any of these rights, write to our Data Protection Officer using the details below. We respond within the period set by the National Privacy Commission.

Cookies

This site uses only the cookies needed to keep pages working and to measure basic traffic. You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings without losing access to the site.
